header: Replays the log of answer attempts through the CURRENT verification rules. No model call, no network, no database: it costs nothing, so I run it after every change. The app writes the log when ANSWER_LOG_FILE is set (put ANSWER_LOG_FILE=reread-reports/answers.jsonl in .env.local, restart the app, and browse: every answer attempt is kept with the model's own reply and the exact passages it was shown). npx tsx --tsconfig tsconfig.json scripts/answer-replay.ts every logged attempt, then a summary npx tsx --tsconfig tsconfig.json scripts/answer-replay.ts --refused only the attempts that are refused NOW npx tsx --tsconfig tsconfig.json scripts/answer-replay.ts --changed only those whose verdict differs from the one logged npx tsx --tsconfig tsconfig.json scripts/answer-replay.ts --file other.jsonl another file (default: reread-reports/answers.jsonl) "acceptedThenRefused" must stay 0 unless I tightened a rule on purpose: it is my regression check for every change to the rules.

symbols.name: shown
symbols.sig: const shown = rows.filter((r) => (flag("refused") ? !r.nowOk : flag("changed") ? r.before !== r.now : true))
